evidence: Modifies core RPC parameter parsing and validation infrastructure in src/rpc/util.cpp, src/rpc/server.cpp, and src/rpc/client.cpp.
rationale: Extending the RPC framework to support distinct types per parameter alias and oneOf schemas improves interface consistency and unblocks parameter additions in PR #32857. As described, the RPC framework previously lacked support for per-alias type checks, preventing methods from cleanly migrating positional booleans to options objects.
